sectionRef: ProcessManager design — stop flow SIGKILL escalation verification
description: stopManagedProcess does not verify the process actually exited after the SIGKILL escalation. killAndWait races the exit event against a timeout and returns silently when the timeout wins. The plan requires: 'If still alive after that, throw StopFailed (rare; expected when the OS itself is stuck)'. Without that check, dev_server.stop and stopAll can report success while the child is still alive, leaving an orphan and breaking the no-orphan AC.
suggestedFix: After the SIGKILL killAndWait race, check managed.status (or use process.kill(pid, 0) to probe liveness); if not exited, throw a new StopFailed error class. Update stopAll to swallow/log StopFailed without short-circuiting the sweep (combined with the allSettled fix in F-005).
